traditional.enunciado: A network engineer is asked to configure VLANs 2, 3, and 4 for a new implementation. Some ports must be assigned to the new VLANs withunused ports remaining. Which action should be taken for the unused ports?
alternativas: configure in a nondefault native VLAN
configure ports in the native VLAN
configure ports in a black hole VLAN
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Unused switch ports should be placed in a black-hole/unused VLAN (and preferably shut down) so they are not left in the default native/user VLAN where they can be abused. Access mode alone without isolation is incomplete; putting them in native VLAN or leaving defaults is insecure.

traditional.enunciado: What mechanism carries multicast traffic between remote sites and supports encryption?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: GRE over IPsec carries multicast (and other) traffic between sites inside a GRE tunnel while IPsec provides encryption. Plain GRE has no crypto. ISATAP is IPv6 transition, not the standard site multicast+encryption design.

traditional.enunciado: Which action implements physical access control as part of the security program of an organization?
alternativas: setting up IP cameras to monitor key infrastructure
configuring a password for the console port
backing up syslogs at a remote location
configuring enable passwords on network devices
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Physical access control protects facilities and equipment via cameras, badges, locks. Console/enable passwords are logical/device access controls, not physical program controls.

traditional.enunciado: Which eld within the access-request packet is encrypted by RADIUS?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: RADIUS encrypts only the password (and secrets) in Access-Request; username and much of the packet are not fully encrypted like TACACS+ body encryption.

traditional.enunciado: A Cisco engineer is configuring a factory-default router with these three passwords:✑ The user EXEC password for console access is p4ssw0rd1.✑ The user EXEC password for Telnet access is s3cr3t2.✑ The password for privileged EXEC mode is priv4t3p4ss.Which command sequence must the engineer configure?
alternativas:
enable secret priv4t3p4ss
!
line con 0
 password p4ssw0rd1
!
line vty 0 15
 password s3cr3t2

enable secret priv4t3p4ss
!
line con 0
 password p4ssw0rd1
 login
!
line vty 0 15
 password s3cr3t2
 login

enable secret priv4t3p4ss
!
line con 0
 password login p4ssw0rd1
!
line vty 0 15
 password login s3cr3t2
 login

enable secret privilege 15 priv4t3p4ss
!
line con 0
 password p4ssw0rd1
 login
!
line vty 0 15
 password s3cr3t2
 login
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Factory-default hardening needs enable secret for privileged EXEC, and password + login on console and VTY for user EXEC. Invalid 'enable secret privilege 15' syntax is wrong; missing login leaves lines without authentication.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #10270 — Roteador de fábrica precisa: enable secret priv4t3p4ss, console user EXEC p4ssw0rd1, VTY Telnet s3cr3t2. Após config, console não pede senha.
ticket.cli_output:
R1# show running-config | section line|enable
enable secret 5 $1$....priv
line con 0
 password p4ssw0rd1
line vty 0 15
 password s3cr3t2
! falta "login" nas linhas

R1# show line con 0 | include Password
Password is set, but login not enabled
alternativas: Adicionar login em line con 0 e line vty 0 15 além de enable secret e passwords.
Usar enable secret privilege 15 priv4t3p4ss como sintaxe correta.
Remover passwords das linhas; só enable secret autentica console.
login local é obrigatório mesmo sem username configurado.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: password sozinho não autentica sem login (ou login local). enable secret privilege 15 é inválido. Com password line, use login.

traditional.enunciado: What is a function of Opportunistic Wireless Encryption in an environment?
alternativas: increase security by using a WEP connection
traditional.explicacao_profunda: OWE (Opportunistic Wireless Encryption) encrypts traffic on open SSIDs without a PSK, improving privacy on open networks. It is not primarily an authentication framework like 802.1X, nor WEP.

traditional.enunciado: Which encryption method is used by WPA3?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: WPA3 personal mode uses SAE (Simultaneous Authentication of Equals). AES is the cipher suite family; TKIP/PSK refer to older WPA/WPA2 concepts.

traditional.enunciado: Which type of traffic is sent with pure IPsec?
alternativas: multicast traffic from a server at one site to hosts at another location
broadcast packets from a switch that is attempting to locate a MAC address at one of several remote sites
unicast messages from a host at a remote site to a server at headquarters
spanning-tree updates between switches that are at two different sites
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Native IPsec (without GRE) typically protects unicast IP flows. Multicast/broadcast and STP are not pure IPsec use cases without additional tunneling.

traditional.enunciado: How does authentication differ from authorization?
alternativas: Authentication is used to record what resource a user accesses, and authorization is used to determine what resources a user can access.
Authentication verifies the identity of a person accessing a network, and authorization determines what resource a user can access.
Authentication is used to determine what resources a user is allowed to access, and authorization is used to traffick what equipment isallowed access to the network.
Authentication is used to verify a person's identity, and authorization is used to create syslog messages for logins.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Authentication verifies identity; authorization determines permitted resources; accounting records activity. Options that swap authN/authZ or describe accounting are incorrect.

traditional.enunciado: An engineer has configured the domain name, user name, and password on the local router. What is the next step to complete the configurationfor a Secure Shell access RSA key?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: After hostname/domain/user setup, generate RSA keys with crypto key generate rsa for SSH. Import/zeroize/pubkey-chain are other key operations, not the next enable step.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #10275 — Hostname, domain e usuário local ok; SSH falha porque não há chave RSA.
ticket.cli_output:
R1# show ip ssh
SSH Disabled - version 1.99
% Please create RSA keys to enable SSH.

R1# show running-config | include hostname|domain|username
hostname R1
ip domain-name lab.local
username admin privilege 15 secret 5 $1$...
alternativas: Executar crypto key generate rsa (modulus adequado) para habilitar SSH.
crypto key zeroize rsa cria a chave necessária.
crypto key import é o único método suportado.
Sem RSA, transport input ssh funciona com Telnet keys.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: SSH no IOS exige par de chaves RSA. generate rsa é o passo; zeroize apaga chaves.

traditional.enunciado: Which wireless security protocol relies on Perfect Forward Secrecy?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: WPA3 provides forward secrecy (SAE/PFS properties). WEP/WPA/WPA2 do not rely on PFS the same way WPA3 does.

traditional.enunciado: Which characteristic differentiates the concept of authentication from authorization and accounting?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Authentication’s distinguishing characteristic is identity verification. Billing is accounting-ish commercial; logging is accounting; service limits are authorization.

traditional.enunciado: What is a function of Cisco Advanced Malware Protection for a Next-Generation IPS?
alternativas: inspecting specific fifiles and file types for malware
traditional.explicacao_profunda: AMP for NGFW/NGIPS inspects files/file types for malware. It is not primarily user auth, wireless authorization, or simple URL filtering alone.

traditional.enunciado: What is a feature of WPA?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Original WPA introduced TKIP/MIC to improve on WEP. PSK and 802.1X are authentication modes that exist across generations; TKIP/MIC is the classic WPA feature named here.

traditional.enunciado: How does WPA3 improve security?
alternativas: It uses a 4-way handshake for authentication.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: WPA3 improves security using SAE instead of the WPA2 PSK 4-way weaknesses. RC4/TKIP are legacy and weaker.

traditional.enunciado: What is a function of a Next-Generation IPS?
alternativas: correlates user activity with network events
serves as a controller within a controller-based network
integrates with a RADIUS server to enforce Layer 2 device authentication rufifiles
makes forwarding decisions based on learned MAC addresses
traditional.explicacao_profunda: NGIPS correlates users/applications with network events for better threat context. It is not a WLAN controller, pure RADIUS authenticator, or L2 MAC switch.

traditional.enunciado: Which IPsec transport mode encrypts the IP header and the payload?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: IPsec tunnel mode protects the original IP header and payload (new outer header). Transport mode encrypts primarily the payload, leaving the original IP header in the clear (with ESP).

traditional.enunciado: Which device separates networks by security domains?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Firewalls separate security domains/zones with policy. IPS detects/prevents threats; WLC/AP are wireless infrastructure.

traditional.enunciado: How are VLAN hopping attacks mitigated?
alternativas: manually implement trunk ports and disable DTP
activate all ports and place in the default VLAN
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Mitigate VLAN hopping by hard-setting trunks, disabling DTP, and careful native VLAN design. DAI mitigates ARP spoofing; activating all ports in default VLAN worsens risk.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #10284 — Segurança reporta risco de VLAN hopping; trunks ainda com DTP desirable e native 1.
ticket.cli_output:
SW1# show interfaces gi1/0/24 switchport
Administrative Mode: dynamic desirable
Operational Mode: trunk
Negotiation of Trunking: On
Trunking Native Mode VLAN: 1 (default)
alternativas: Fixar switchport mode trunk, switchport nonegotiate (disable DTP) e native VLAN não default.
Ativar todas as portas na VLAN 1 reduz hopping.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: Mitigações clássicas: trunks manuais, DTP off, native VLAN unused. DAI é ARP; VLAN 1 default aumenta risco.

traditional.enunciado: Which enhancements were implemented as part of WPA3?
alternativas: Forward secrecy and SAE in personal mode for secure initial key exchange
AES-64 in personal mode and AES-128 in enterprise mode
TKIP encryption improving WEP and per-packet keying
traditional.explicacao_profunda: WPA3 adds SAE and forward secrecy in personal mode. TKIP/WEP improvements are older WPA ideas; AES-64 is nonsense.

traditional.enunciado: When a site-to-site VPN is configured which IPsec mode provides encapsulation and encryption of the entire original IP packet?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Site-to-site VPNs use IPsec tunnel mode with ESP to encapsulate and encrypt the entire original IP packet. Transport mode does not encapsulate the original header the same way; AH provides integrity without ESP confidentiality.

traditional.enunciado: In an SDN architecture, which function of a network node is centralized on a controller?
alternativas: Provides protocol access for remote access devices
traditional.explicacao_profunda: In SDN, the controller centralizes control-plane decisions (routing/forwarding policy). Data plane still forwards; filtering discard is data-plane action; remote access is management.

traditional.enunciado: Which management security profficess is invoked when a user logs in to a network device using their username and password?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Login with username/password invokes authentication. Authorization follows for privileges; accounting/auditing track sessions.

traditional.enunciado: Which enhancement is implemented in WPA3?
alternativas: employs PKI to identify access points
traditional.explicacao_profunda: WPA3 SAE strengthens resistance to offline brute-force/dictionary attacks on personal networks versus WPA2-PSK.

traditional.enunciado: Which port security violation mode allows from valid MAC addresses to pass but blocks traffic from invalid MAC addresses?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Port-security protect mode silently drops frames from unknown MACs while allowing known ones; no SNMP/syslog increment like restrict, and no err-disable like shutdown.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #10290 — Port-security deve descartar MACs inválidos sem err-disable e sem log SNMP. Porta impressora.
ticket.cli_output:
SW1# show port-security interface gi1/0/8
Port Security              : Enabled
Violation Mode             : Shutdown
Maximum MAC Addresses      : 1
Security Violation Count   : 2
Port Status                : Secure-shutdown

SW1# show running-config interface gi1/0/8
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/8
 switchport port-security
 switchport port-security maximum 1
 switchport port-security violation shutdown
alternativas: Alterar para switchport port-security violation protect.
violation shutdown é o único modo que não derruba a porta.
restrict nunca conta violações; é igual a protect.
shutdown VLAN é o modo que só descarta frames silenciosamente.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: protect descarta frames de MACs desconhecidos sem syslog/SNMP e sem err-disable. restrict loga; shutdown err-disable.

traditional.enunciado: A customer wants to provide wireless access to contraffictors using a guest portal on Cisco ISE. The portal is also used by employees. A solution is implemented, but contraffictors receive a certificate error when they attempt to access the portal. Employees can access the portal without anyerrors. Which change must be implemented to allow the contraffictors and employees to access the portal?
alternativas: Install an Internal CA signed certificate on the Cisco ISE.
Install a trusted third-party certificate on the Cisco ISE.
Install an internal CA signed certificate on the contraffictor devices.
Install a trusted third-party certificate on the contraffictor devices.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Guest portals need a publicly trusted certificate on ISE so contractor browsers do not show cert errors. Internal CA fails on unmanaged contractor devices unless the CA is pre-trusted.

traditional.enunciado: A network engineer is implementing a corporate SSID for WPA3-Personal security with a PSK. Which encryption cipher must be configured?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: WPA3-Personal with PSK commonly uses CCMP-128 (AES-CCMP). GCMP-256 is more aligned with WPA3-Enterprise 192-bit mode options, not the basic personal PSK case in this item.

traditional.enunciado: What is a practice that protects a network from VLAN hopping attacks?
alternativas: Implement port security on internet-facing VLANs
Assign all access ports to VLANs other than the native VLAN
configure an ACL to prevent traffic from changing VLANs
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Avoid placing access ports in the native VLAN used on trunks; keep user access VLANs distinct from native to reduce hopping impact. DAI/port-security address other threats.

traditional.enunciado: An organization has decided to start using cloud-provided services. Which cloud service allows the organization to install its own operatingsystem on a virtual machine?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: IaaS provides virtualized compute/storage/network infrastructure the org manages (OS up). SaaS is apps; PaaS is runtime platforms.

traditional.enunciado: How do traditional campus device management and Cisco DNA Center device management differ in regards to deployment?
alternativas: Traditional campus device management allows a network to scale more quickly than with Cisco DNA Center device management.
Cisco DNA Center device management can deploy a network more quickly than traditional campus device management.
Cisco DNA Center device management can be implemented at a lower cost than most traditional campus device management options.
Traditional campus device management schemes can typically deploy patches and updates more quickly than Cisco DNA Center devicemanagement.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: DNA Center deploys consistent configuration/policy across many devices centrally. Traditional management is often device-by-device CLI.

traditional.enunciado: Which purpose does a northbound API serve in a controller-based networking architecture?
alternativas: facilitates communication between the controller and the applications
reports device errors to a controller
generates statistics for network hardware and traffic
communicates between the controller and the physical network hardware
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Northbound APIs let applications/orchestration talk to the controller. Southbound talks to network devices.

traditional.enunciado: What benefit does controller-based networking provide versus traditional networking?
alternativas: allows configuration and monitoring of the network from one centralized point
provides an added layer of security to protect from DDoS attacks
combines control and data plane functionality on a single device to minimize latency
moves from a two-tier to a three-tier network architecture to provide maximum redundancy
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Controller-based networking enables centralized configuration and monitoring versus per-box traditional management. It separates control from data plane rather than combining them on every box only.

traditional.enunciado: What is an advantage of Cisco DNA Center versus traditional campus device management?
alternativas: It is designed primarily to provide network assurance.
It supports numerous extensibility options, including cross-domain adapters and third-party SDKs.
It supports high availability for management functions when operating in cluster mode.
It enabfifiles easy autodiscovery of network elements in a browneld deployment.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: DNA Center offers broad extensibility (REST APIs, integrations) beyond classic campus managers focused only on discovery/assurance HA.

traditional.enunciado: How does Cisco DNA Center gather data from the network?
alternativas: Devices use the call-home protocol to periodically send data to the controller
Devices establish an IPsec tunnel to exchange data with the controller
The Cisco CLI Analyzer tool gathers data from each licensed network device and streams it to the controller
Network devices use different services like SNMP, syslog, and streaming telemetry to send data to the controller
traditional.explicacao_profunda: DNA Center collects via SNMP, syslog, NetFlow/telemetry, and device adapters—not a single IPsec call-home-only model.

traditional.enunciado: Which statement compares traditional networks and controller-based networks?
alternativas: Only controller-based networks decouple the control plane and the data plane.
Traditional and controller-based networks abstraffict policies from device configurations.
Only traditional networks natively support centralized management.
Only traditional networks offer a centralized control plane.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Controller-based networks explicitly decouple control and data planes; traditional boxes co-locate both. Centralized control is the SDN trait, not traditional-only.

traditional.enunciado: What software-defined architecture plane assists network devices with making packet-forwarding decisions by providing Layer 2 reachability andLayer 3 routing information?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: The control plane computes forwarding information used by the data plane. Management is device ops; data plane forwards; policy is higher intent.

traditional.enunciado: Which type of API allows SDN controllers to dynamically make changes to the network?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Southbound APIs let the controller program network devices dynamically. Northbound faces apps; REST/SOAP are styles that can be used either direction depending on design.

traditional.enunciado: Which option about JSON is true -
alternativas: uses predefined tags or angle brackets () to delimit markup text
used to describe structured data that includes arrays
similar to HTML, it is more verbose than XML
traditional.explicacao_profunda: JSON represents structured data including objects and arrays with key/value syntax. It is less verbose than XML and does not use HTML-like angle-bracket markup as its model.

traditional.enunciado: Which option best describes an API?
alternativas: a contraffict that describes how various components communicate and exchange data with each other
an architectural style (versus a protocol) for designing applications
request a certain type of data by specifying the URL path that models the data
traditional.explicacao_profunda: An API is a contract defining how software components interact. REST is one architectural style; URL paths are usage details of HTTP APIs.

traditional.enunciado: Which of the following is the JSON encoding of a dictionary or hash?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: A JSON object/dictionary is encoded as {"key": "value"}. Arrays use []; tuples/parens are not JSON objects.

traditional.enunciado: Which role does a hypervisor provide for each virtual machine in server virtualization?
alternativas: control and distribution of physical resources
traditional.explicacao_profunda: The hypervisor allocates and schedules physical CPU, memory, storage, and I/O among VMs. IaaS/SaaS are cloud service models, not the hypervisor’s per-VM role.

traditional.enunciado: What is the function of a server?
alternativas: It transmits packets between hosts in the same broadcast domain.
It provides shared applications to end users.
It routes traffic between Layer 3 devices.
It cccreates security zones between trusted and untrusted networks.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Servers provide shared applications/services to clients. Switches forward in a LAN; routers route; firewalls zone.

traditional.enunciado: Which CRUD operation modies an existing table or view?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: CRUD Update modifies existing resources/tables/views. Create inserts; Read retrieves; Replace is not the standard CRUD verb name here.

traditional.enunciado: In software-defined architectures, which plane is distributed and responsible for traffic forwarding?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: In SDN, the data plane remains distributed on devices for traffic forwarding; control is centralized on the controller.

traditional.enunciado: Which configuration management mechanism uses TCP port 22 by default when communicating with managed nodes?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Ansible connects to managed nodes primarily over SSH (TCP 22). Puppet/Chef commonly use agent/TLS ports; Python is a language.

traditional.enunciado: What does an SDN controller use as a communication protocol to relay forwarding changes to a southbound API?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: OpenFlow is a classic southbound protocol for an SDN controller to install forwarding entries on switches. REST is often northbound; Java/XML are not the forwarding SB protocol named here.

traditional.enunciado: What uses HTTP messages to transfer data to applications residing on different hosts?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: REST uses HTTP methods/messages to exchange data between clients and application services on hosts. OpenFlow/OpFlex are SDN southbound; OpenStack is a cloud platform.

traditional.enunciado: Which JSON data type is an unordered set of attribute-value pairs?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: A JSON object is an unordered set of name/value pairs. Arrays are ordered lists; string/boolean are primitives.

traditional.enunciado: Which protocol is used in Software defined Access (SDA) to provide a tunnel between two edge nodes in different fabrics?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Cisco SD-Access fabric uses VXLAN (with LISP control) to tunnel between edge nodes. GRE/VLAN/PPP are not the SDA fabric data-plane encapsulation.

traditional.enunciado: Which plane is centralized by an SDN controller?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: SDN controllers centralize the control plane. Data plane stays on devices; management/services planes are separate concepts.

traditional.enunciado: Where is the interface between the control plane and data plane within the software-defined architecture?
alternativas: application layer and the management layer
application layer and the infrastructure layer
control layer and the application layer
control layer and the infrastructure layer
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Southbound interface sits between control layer (controller) and infrastructure layer (switches/routers). Northbound is control↔application.

traditional.enunciado: Why would a network administrator choose to implement automation in a network environment?
alternativas: To simplify the profficess of maintaining a consistent configuration state across all devices
To implement centralized user account management
To deploy the management plane separately from the rest of the network
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Automation reduces configuration drift and makes consistent configs easier to maintain at scale. It is not mainly about splitting management plane alone.

traditional.enunciado: In software-defined architecture, which plane handfiles switching for traffic through a Cisco router?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Packet switching/forwarding through a router is data-plane work. Control plane builds tables; management configures the device.

traditional.enunciado: What makes Cisco DNA Center different from traditional network management applications and their management of networks?
alternativas: Its modular design allows the implementation of different versions to meet the specific needs of an organization.
It only supports auto-discovery of network elements in a greeneld deployment.
It omits support high availability of management functions when operating in cluster mode.
It abstrafficts policy from the actual device configuration.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: DNA Center abstracts intent/policy from per-device CLI configuration, unlike traditional EMS tools that push device-centric configs.

traditional.enunciado: Which API is used in controller-based architectures to interact with edge devices?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Southbound APIs interact with edge/infrastructure devices. Northbound faces applications/orchestration.

traditional.enunciado: What differentiates device management enabled by Cisco DNA Center from traditional campus device management?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: DNA Center enables centralized device management versus traditional per-device hands-on CLI.

traditional.enunciado: How do servers connect to the network in a virtual environment?
alternativas: a cable connected to a physical switch on the network
wireless to an access point that is physically connected to the network
a virtual switch that links to an access point that is physically connected to the network
a software switch on a hypervisor that is physically connected to the network
traditional.explicacao_profunda: VMs connect via a virtual switch in the hypervisor, which uplinks to the physical network. Not purely wireless AP attachment as the general model.

traditional.enunciado: What is the function of the controller in a software-defined network?
alternativas: multicast replication at the hardware level
traditional.explicacao_profunda: The SDN controller makes control decisions (routing/policy programming). Forwarding/replication/reassembly are data-plane device functions.

traditional.enunciado: What is a function of a southbound API?
alternativas: Use orchestration to provision a virtual server configuration from a web server
Automate configuration changes between a server and a switching fabric
Manage flflow control between an SDN controller and a switching fabric
Facilitate the information exchange between an SDN controller and application
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Southbound APIs manage flow/control programming between controller and switches. Northbound is controller↔apps.

traditional.enunciado: Which script paradigm does Puppet use?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Puppet uses manifests and modules. Chef uses recipes/cookbooks; Ansible uses playbooks/roles.

traditional.enunciado: Which set of methods is supported with the REST API?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: REST standard methods include GET, PUT, POST, DELETE (and PATCH). ERASE/MOD/CHANGE are not standard REST verbs.

traditional.enunciado: Which technology is appropriate for communication between an SDN controller and applications running over the network?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Communication between SDN controller and applications is northbound, commonly REST. OpenFlow/NETCONF are device-facing southbound styles.

traditional.enunciado: What is the function of `off-the-shelf` switches in a controller-based network?
alternativas: providing a central view of the deployed network
traditional.explicacao_profunda: In controller-based networks, white-box/off-the-shelf switches focus on forwarding packets under controller programming; policy and routing decisions are centralized.

traditional.enunciado: Which REST method updates an object in the Cisco DNA Center Intent API?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: HTTP PUT updates/replaces a resource in REST/DNA Intent APIs. POST typically creates; UPDATE/CHANGE are not standard HTTP methods.

traditional.enunciado: Which definition describes JWT in regard to REST API security?
alternativas: an encrypted JSON token that is used for authentication
an encrypted JSON token that is used for authorization
an encoded JSON token that is used to securely exchange information
an encoded JSON token that is used for authentication
traditional.explicacao_profunda: JWT is an encoded (optionally signed/encrypted) JSON token used to securely exchange claims for authN/authZ between parties—not merely a vague encrypted blob description without the exchange purpose.

traditional.enunciado: Which communication interaction takes place when a southbound API is used?
alternativas: between the SDN controller and PCs on the network
between the SDN controller and switches and routers on the network
between the SDN controller and services and applications on the network
between network applications and switches and routers on the network
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Southbound API traffic is controller ↔ network devices (switches/routers). Apps use northbound.

traditional.enunciado: What is an expected outcome when network management automation is deployed?
alternativas: A distributed management plane must be used.
Complexity increases when new device configurations are added.
Custom applications are needed to configure network devices.
Software upgrades are performed from a central controller.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Automation outcomes include centralized software upgrades and consistent changes from a controller/orchestrator. Complexity should decrease for routine config; custom apps are not always required.

traditional.enunciado: Which HTTP status code is returned after a successful REST API request?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: HTTP 200 OK indicates successful REST requests. 301 redirect, 404 not found, 500 server error are not success.

traditional.enunciado: With REST API, which standard HTTP header tells a server which media type is expected by the client?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Accept header tells the server which media types the client expects (e.g., application/json). Content-Type describes the body being sent.

traditional.enunciado: What is the purpose of the Cisco DNA Center controller?
alternativas: to securely manage and deploy network devices
to scan a network and generate a Layer 2 network diagram
to secure physical access to a data center
to provide Layer 3 services to autonomous access points
traditional.explicacao_profunda: DNA Center securely manages, provisions, and assures network devices with centralized automation. It is not primarily a physical security system or AP-only L3 service box.

traditional.enunciado: What is the function of the controller in a software-defined network?
alternativas: multicast replication at the hardware level
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Controllers set packet-handling policies/forwarding intent. Actual forwarding is data plane on devices.

traditional.enunciado: Which statement identifies the functionality of virtual machines?
alternativas: Virtualized servers run most efficiently when they are physically connected to a switch that is separate from the hypervisor
The hypervisor can virtualize physical components including CPU, memory, and storage
Each hypervisor can support a single virtual machine and a single software switch
The hypervisor communicates on Layer 3 without the need for additional resources
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Hypervisors virtualize CPU, memory, storage, and NICs for multiple VMs. They are not limited to one VM; efficiency does not require a physically separate switch from the host.

traditional.enunciado: Which network plane is centralized and manages routing decisions?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Centralized routing decisions are control-plane functions in SDN. Data plane forwards; management configures; policy is intent layer.

traditional.enunciado: What is a benefit of using private IPv4 addressing?
alternativas: Multiple companies can use the same addresses without conflicts.
Direct connectivity is provided to internal hosts from outside an enterprise network.
Communication to the internet is reachable without the use of NAT.
All external hosts are provided with secure communication to the internet.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Private IPv4 lets many organizations reuse RFC1918 space without global uniqueness conflicts. It does not provide direct Internet reachability without NAT/proxy.

traditional.enunciado: Which element of a virtualization solution manages virtualized services and enabfiles connections between virtualized services and externalinterfaces?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Virtual machines are the virtualized compute endpoints; the hypervisor/software stack enables connectivity between VMs and physical resources. The VM is the element hosting virtualized services in this framing.

traditional.enunciado: Which group of channels in the 802.11b/g/n/ac/ax 2.4 GHz frequency bands are nonoverlapping channels?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: In 2.4 GHz, nonoverlapping channels are 1, 6, and 11 (in most regulatory domains).

traditional.enunciado: What is a function of Layer 3 switches?
alternativas: They route traffic between devices in different VLANs.
They transmit broadcast traffic when operating in Layer 3 mode exclusively.
They move frames between endpoints limited to IP addresses.
They forward Ethernet frames between VLANs using only MAC addresses,
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Layer 3 switches route IP between VLANs/SVIs (inter-VLAN routing). They do not forward between VLANs using only MAC, nor exist solely to blast broadcasts in L3 mode.

traditional.enunciado: Which cable type must be used to interconnect one switch using 1000 BASE-SX GBIC modufiles and another switch using 1000 BASE-SX SFPmodufiles?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: GBIC SX links typically use SC connectors; interconnecting two SC GBICs needs SC-to-SC fiber. LC is SFP-era more often; ST is another form factor.

traditional.enunciado: What is a benefit of a point-to-point leased line?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Point-to-point leased lines are simple to configure (two endpoints, clear L3). They are not low-cost or full-mesh by nature.

traditional.enunciado: What is the role of nonoverlapping channels in a wireless environment?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Nonoverlapping channels reduce co-channel interference and stabilize RF performance. They do not by themselves invent bandwidth or define bonding.

traditional.enunciado: What is the purpose of the service-set identifier?
alternativas: It identifies the wireless network to which an application must connect.
It identifies the wired network to which a network device is connected.
It identifies the wired network to which a user device is connected.
It identifies a wireless network for a mobile device to connect.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: The SSID identifies a wireless network so clients can discover and connect. It does not identify wired VLANs/networks.

traditional.enunciado: Which is a fact related to FTP?
alternativas: It always operates without user authentication.
It uses block numbers to identify and mitigate data-transfer errors.
It uses two separate connections for control and data tra
It relies on the well-known UDP port 69.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: FTP uses separate control and data TCP connections. TFTP uses UDP/69 and block numbers; FTP authenticates users.

traditional.enunciado: How do UTP and STP cabfiles compare?
alternativas: UTP cabfifiles provide faster and more reliable data transfer rates and STP cabfifiles are slower and less reliable.
STP cabfifiles are shielded and protect against electromagnetic interference and UTP lacks the same protection against electromagneticinterference.
STP cabfifiles are cheaper to procure and easier to install and UTP cabfifiles are more expensive and harder to install.
UTP cabfifiles are less prone to crosstalk and interference and STP cabfifiles are more prone to crosstalk and interference.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: STP cable has shielding against EMI; UTP does not. UTP is usually cheaper; STP is not generally faster Ethernet by definition.

traditional.enunciado: Which technology allows for multiple operating systems to be run on a single host computer?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Server virtualization runs multiple OSes on one physical host via a hypervisor. VRF/VDC/NPIV are networking virtualization concepts.

traditional.enunciado: Why would an administrator choose to implement an automated network management solution?
alternativas: to enable “box by box” configuration and deployment
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Automation reduces operational cost and human error versus box-by-box management. It does not aim to enforce simpler passwords as the primary reason.

traditional.enunciado: What is a function of the core and distribution layers in a collapsed-core architecture?
alternativas: The router can support HSRP for Layer 2 redundancy in an IPv6 network.
The core and distribution layers are deployed on two different devices to enable failover.
The router operates on a single device or a redundant pair.
The router must use IPv4 and IPv6 addresses at Layer 3.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Collapsed-core combines core and distribution on the same device (or redundant pair). It is not two separate layers of devices.

traditional.enunciado: What must be considered before deploying virtual machines?
alternativas: resource limitations, such as the number of CPU cores and the amount of memory
support for physical peripherals, such as monitors, keyboards, and mice
whether to leverage VSM to map multiple virtual profficessors to two or more virtual machines
location of the virtual machines within the data center environment
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Before deploying VMs, plan CPU, memory, storage, and I/O capacity limits. Peripherals/location are secondary to resource sizing.

traditional.enunciado: What is a link-local all-nodes IPv6 multicast address?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: IPv6 all-nodes link-local multicast is ff02::1. fe80::/10 is link-local unicast; 2000::/3 global unicast examples are not all-nodes multicast.

traditional.enunciado: Which is a reason to implement IPv4 private addressing?
alternativas: Reduce the size of the forwarding table on network routers.
Reduce the risk of a network security breach.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Private addressing reduces direct Internet exposure of hosts (with perimeter controls/NAT). It is not primarily PCI text or FIB reduction.

traditional.enunciado: Which signal frequency appears 60 times per minute?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Frequency f=1 Hz means one cycle per second = 60 cycles per minute. 60 Hz is 60 cycles per second.

traditional.enunciado: What is a function of spine-and-leaf architecture?
alternativas: offers predictable latency of the traffic path between end devices
mitigates oversubscription by adding a layer of leaf switches
exclusively sends multicast traffic between servers that are directly connected to the spine
limits payload size of traffic within the leaf layer
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Spine-leaf provides predictable any-to-any latency/bandwidth with ECMP leaf-spine fabric. Adding only leafs without spines is not the oversubscription mitigation story alone.

traditional.enunciado: What is a function of an endpoint?
alternativas: It passes unicast communication between hosts in a network.
It transmits broadcast traffic between devices in the same VLAN.
It provides security between trusted and untrusted sections of the network.
It is used directly by an individual user to access network services.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Endpoints (PCs, phones, printers) are used directly by users to access network services. Intermediate systems forward; firewalls zone.

traditional.enunciado: What is a function of MAC address learning?
alternativas: It is disabled by default on all interfaces connected to trunks.
It increases security on the management VLAN.
It is enabled by default on all VLANs and interfaces.
It increases the potential for MAC address flflooding.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: MAC learning is enabled by default so switches build the CAM table from source MACs on VLANs/ports. It does not inherently increase management VLAN security.

traditional.enunciado: Which IPv6 address range is suitable for anycast addresses for distributed services such as DHCP or DNS?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Anycast is typically a unicast global address assigned to multiple hosts; 2001:db8::/32 documentation space /128 is a unicast form suitable as anycast target. ff00::/8 is multicast; fe80:: link-local.

traditional.enunciado: What is a similarity between OM3 and OM4 fiber optic cable?
alternativas: Both have a 62.5 micron core diameter.
Both have a 100 micron core diameter.
Both have a 50 micron core diameter.
Both have a 9 micron core diameter.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: OM3 and OM4 are 50 µm multimode fiber optimized for laser/VCSEL. OM1 is 62.5 µm; OS1/OS2 single-mode ~9 µm.

traditional.enunciado: Which device segregates a network into separate zones that have their own security policies?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Firewalls create security zones with distinct policies. IPS detects threats; switches/APs segment differently.

traditional.enunciado: What is the primary purpose of private address space?
alternativas: limit the number of nodes reachable via the Internet
simplify the addressing in the network
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Private address space conserves public IPv4 by allowing internal reuse. Simplification/complexity reduction are secondary benefits.

traditional.enunciado: What is a characteristic of a collapsed-core network topology?
alternativas: It enabfifiles all workstations in a SOHO environment to connect on a single switch with internet access.
It enabfifiles the core and access layers to connect to one logical distribution device over an EtherChannel.
It allows wireless devices to connect directly to the core layer, which enabfifiles faster data transmission.
It allows the core and distribution layers to run as a single combined layer.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Collapsed-core runs core+distribution functions together on one layer/pair of devices. Access still connects users.

traditional.enunciado: What is the functionality of the Cisco DNA Center?
alternativas: console server that permits secure access to all network devices
software-defined controller for automation of devices and services
traditional.explicacao_profunda: DNA Center is the software-defined controller for automation, assurance, and policy of enterprise devices.

traditional.enunciado: Which functionality is provided by the console connection on a Cisco WLC?
alternativas: secure in-band connectivity for device administration
unencrypted in-band connectivity for file transfers
traditional.explicacao_profunda: WLC console provides out-of-band management access. HTTP GUI is in-band web; service port is the dedicated OOB Ethernet in many models.

traditional.enunciado: How does Rapid PVST+ create a fast loop-free network topology?
alternativas: It uses multiple active paths between end stations.
It requires multiple links between core switches.
It maps multiple VLANs into the same spanning-tree instance.
It generates one spanning-tree instance for each VLAN.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Rapid PVST+ runs one STP instance per VLAN for fast per-VLAN loop-free topology. MST maps VLANs to fewer instances; multiple active paths would be a loop without special multipath tech.

traditional.enunciado: A network administrator plans an update to the WI-FI networks in multiple branch offices. Each location is configured with an SSID called “office”.The administrator wants every user who connects to the SSID at any location to have the same access level. What must be set the same on eachnetwork to meet the requirement?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: When the same WLAN profile is reused across branches, NAS-ID (and site identifiers) help AAA distinguish locations. Radio/security may be shared; NAS-ID is the differentiation keyed here.

traditional.enunciado: Which command enabfiles HTTP access to the Cisco WLC?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: On AireOS WLC CLI, config network webmode enable allows HTTP access to the GUI. secureweb is HTTPS; telnet is CLI; certificate generate is related but not the enable for HTTP mode.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #10368 — Precisam acessar a GUI do WLC via HTTP (lab). HTTPS ok; HTTP recusado.
ticket.cli_output:
WLC) > show network summary
Web Mode.................................... Disable
Secure Web Mode............................. Enable

WLC) > ping 10.0.0.50
!!!!!
alternativas: Habilitar config network webmode enable para HTTP na GUI.
config network telnet enable libera HTTP.
config network secureweb enable desliga HTTPS e liga HTTP.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: Web Mode = HTTP GUI. secureweb = HTTPS. Telnet é CLI. Certificado não substitui o enable de webmode.

traditional.enunciado: Which port state profficesses BPDUs, but does not forward packets or update the address database in Rapid PVST+?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: In classic STP states, blocking (or discarding in RSTP) processes BPDUs but does not forward frames or learn MACs. Learning updates MAC table; listening does not learn on classic STP the same way.

traditional.enunciado: A switch is forwarding a frame out of all interfaces except the interface that received the frame. What is the technical term for this profficess?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Unknown unicast/broadcast flooding sends a frame out all ports in the VLAN except the ingress. ARP/CDP/multicast are protocols or traffic types, not the switch action name.

traditional.enunciado: Which switch concept is used to create separate broadcast domains?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: VLANs create separate broadcast domains. STP breaks loops; VTP propagates VLAN DB; CSMA/CD is media access.

traditional.enunciado: How must a switch interface be configured when an AP is in FlexConnect mode?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: FlexConnect APs often use access ports when a single management/data VLAN is switched locally; trunk is used when multiple local WLANs/VLANs must be tagged. This bank keys access mode for the FlexConnect interface.

traditional.enunciado: What is the root port in STP?
alternativas: It is the port with the highest priority toward the root bridge.
It is the port on the root switch that leads to the designated port on another switch.
It is the port that is elected only when the root bridge has precisely one port on a single LAN segment.
It is the port on a switch with the lowest cost to reach the root bridge.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Root port is the port on a non-root switch with lowest path cost to the root bridge. It is not defined by highest priority toward root.

traditional.enunciado: When a switch receives a frame from an unknown source MAC address, which action does the switch take with the frame?
alternativas: It sends the frame to ports within the CAM table identied with an unknown source MAC address.
It floods the frame out all interfaces, including the interface it was received on.
It associates the source MAC address with the LAN port on which it was received and saves it to the MAC address table.
It attempts to send the frame back to the source to ensure that the source MAC address is still available for transmissions.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: On unknown source MAC, the switch learns/associates the source MAC to the ingress port in the CAM table (and may flood if dest unknown). It does not flood including the ingress, nor bounce the frame to source as the primary action.

traditional.enunciado: When the LAG configuration is updated on a Cisco WLC, which additional task must be performed when changes are complete?
alternativas: Flush all MAC addresses from the WLC.
Re-associate the WLC with the access point.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: After LAG changes on a Cisco WLC, a reboot is required for the port-channel membership to apply cleanly.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #10375 — LAG recém-alterado no WLC; port-channel no switch não agrega como esperado.
ticket.cli_output:
WLC) > show lag summary
LAG Enabled

SW1# show etherchannel summary
Group  Port-channel  Protocol    Ports
1      Po1(SU)         -         Gi1/0/1(P) Gi1/0/2(D)

! mudança de interfaces LAG no WLC ainda não refletida após config
alternativas: Reboot do WLC após alteração de LAG para aplicar membership.
Só flush de MAC no WLC aplica LAG.
Re-enable interfaces no switch sem reboot no WLC basta sempre.
Reassociar APs reconfigura LAG do distribution port.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: Mudanças de LAG no AireOS WLC exigem reboot do controller. MAC flush/AP reassoc não aplicam o bundle.

traditional.enunciado: A network engineer starts to implement a new wireless LAN by configuring the authentication server and creating the dynamic interface. Whatmust be performed next to complete the basic configuration?
alternativas: Create the new WLAN and bind the dynamic interface to it.
configure high availability and redundancy for the access points.
Enable Telnet and RADIUS access on the management interface.
Install the management interface and add the management IP.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Basic WLAN bring-up sequence: management connectivity, dynamic interfaces, AAA, then create WLAN and bind the dynamic interface. HA and Telnet are not the immediate next basic step.

traditional.enunciado: Which command configures the Cisco WLC to prevent a serial session with the WLC CLI from being automatically logged out?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: config serial timeout 0 prevents the serial/console CLI session from timing out automatically on the WLC.

traditional.enunciado: A Cisco engineer at a new branch office is configuring a wireless network with access points that connect to a controller that is based at corporateheadquarters. Wireless client traffic must terminate at the branch office and access-point survivability is required in the event of a WAN outage.Which access point mode must be selected?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Branch APs with WAN-limited controller connectivity use FlexConnect with local switching so user data can bridge locally if CAPWAP is constrained.

traditional.enunciado: What is an advantage of using auto mode versus static mode for power allocation when an access point is connected to a PoE switch port?
alternativas: Power policing is enabled at the same time.
The default level is used for the access point.
All four pairs of the cable are used.
It detects the device is a powered device.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: PoE auto mode discovers the powered device class via negotiation (CDP/LLDP/802.3af) rather than static watt allocation. Four-pair is not guaranteed by auto alone.

traditional.enunciado: What is a specification for SSIDs?
alternativas: They must include one number and one letter.
They are a Cisco proprietary security feature.
They dene the VLAN on a switch.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: SSIDs are case-sensitive text identifiers. They are not proprietary-only, do not require letter+number, and do not themselves define switch VLANs.

traditional.enunciado: What is a reason to configure a trunk port that connects to a WLC distribution port?
alternativas: Provide redundancy if there is a link failure for out-of-band management.
Allow multiple VLANs to be used in the data path.
Permit multiple VLANs to provide out-of-band management.
Eliminate redundancy with a link failure in the data path.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Trunking the WLC distribution ports allows multiple user VLANs in the data path. OOB management is usually service port, not the reason for data trunking.

traditional.enunciado: Which switching feature removes unused MAC addresses from the MAC address table, which allows new MAC addresses to be added?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: MAC aging removes inactive dynamic entries so the table can learn new addresses. Move/auto-purge names are not the standard feature title.

traditional.enunciado: Which WLC port connects to a switch to pass normal access-point traffic?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Distribution system ports connect the WLC to the switched network for AP and client data paths. Service is OOB; console is serial; redundancy is SSO link.

traditional.enunciado: What is the primary purpose of a console port on a Cisco WLC?
alternativas: in-band management via an asynchronous transport
in-band management via an IP transport
out-of-band management via an asynchronous transport
out-of-band management via an IP transport
traditional.explicacao_profunda: WLC console port is out-of-band management over asynchronous serial. It is not IP transport.

traditional.enunciado: Which port type does a lightweight AP use to connect to the wired network when it is configured in local mode?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Local-mode lightweight APs typically attach with an access port in the AP management VLAN; CAPWAP tunnels user VLANs. Trunks are more common in FlexConnect multi-VLAN designs.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #10385 — AP lightweight local mode não sobe CAPWAP; porta do switch está trunk nativo errado.
ticket.cli_output:
SW1# show running-config interface gi1/0/12
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/12
 description AP-LOCAL
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk native vlan 1
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 1,10,20

AP# show capwap client rcb
! Discovery failing / wrong VLAN
alternativas: Em local mode, usar access na VLAN de management do AP (CAPWAP), não trunk multi-VLAN desnecessário.
EtherChannel é obrigatório para todo AP local mode.
Trunk é sempre mandatório em local mode centralizado.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: Local mode: AP em access na VLAN de gerência; user VLANs vão no túnel CAPWAP. Trunk multi-VLAN é típico de FlexConnect local switching.

traditional.enunciado: Which step immediately follows receipt of the EAP success message when session resumption is disabled for an EAP-TLS connection?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: After EAP-Success (without session resumption shortcuts), the 4-way handshake derives PTK/GTK for data protection.

traditional.enunciado: What is a reason to implement LAG on a Cisco WLC?
alternativas: Allow for stateful failover between WLCs.
Increase security by encrypting management frames.
Increase the available throughput on the link.
Enable the connected switch ports to use different Layer 2 configurations.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: LAG increases aggregate throughput and provides link redundancy between WLC and switch. It is not primarily inter-WLC stateful failover or management-frame encryption.

traditional.enunciado: A wireless access point is needed and must meet these requirements:• “zero-touch” deployed and managed by a WLC• profficess only real-time MAC functionality• used in a split-MAC architectureWhich access point type must be used?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Zero-touch lightweight APs join a WLC via CAPWAP and are centrally managed. Autonomous is self-managed; mesh/cloud are other deployment models.

traditional.enunciado: Which interface is used for out-of-band management on a WLC?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: The service port is the WLC out-of-band management Ethernet interface. Management is in-band; virtual is for mobility/webauth; dynamic maps WLANs.

traditional.enunciado: A network engineer must migrate a router loopback interface to the IPv6 address space. If the current IPv4 address of the interface is10.54.73.1/32, and the engineer configures IPv6 address 0:0:0:0:0:ffff:a36:4901, which prefix length must be used?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: A single IPv4 loopback host maps cleanly to IPv6 /128. /64 is a subnet, not a single host loopback equivalent.

traditional.enunciado: A Cisco engineer notices that two OSPF neighbors are connected using a crossover Ethernet cable. The neighbors are taking too long to becomefully adjacent. Which command must be issued under the interface configuration on each router to reduce the time required for the adjacency toreach the FULL state?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Two routers on Ethernet with crossover still default to OSPF broadcast (DR election). ip ospf network point-to-point removes DR/BDR on that link.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #10391 — Dois roteadores OSPF ligados por cabo crossover Ethernet elegem DR/BDR; desejam ponto a ponto.
ticket.cli_output:
R1# show ip ospf interface gi0/0
Network Type BROADCAST, Cost: 1
State DR, Priority 1
Designated Router (ID) 1.1.1.1
Backup Designated router (ID) 2.2.2.2
alternativas: ip ospf network point-to-point no link elimina eleição DR/BDR.
ip ospf network broadcast remove DR.
priority 0 em ambos impede adjacência total.
dead-interval 40 sozinho muda o network type.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: point-to-point é o network type correto para link /30 sem DR. broadcast força DR/BDR.

traditional.enunciado: What is the benefit of using FHRP?
alternativas: reduced ARP traffic on the network
balancing traffic across multiple gateways in proportion to their loads
reduced management overhead on network routers
traditional.explicacao_profunda: FHRP increases first-hop availability with virtual gateway redundancy. GLBP can load-balance; classic HSRP benefit stated here is availability.

traditional.enunciado: Why is a first-hop redundancy protocol implemented?
alternativas: to enable multiple switches to operate as a single unit
to provide load-sharing for a multilink segment
to prevent loops in a network
to protect against default gateway failures
traditional.explicacao_profunda: FHRP is implemented to protect against default gateway failures. Loop prevention is STP; stacking is multichassis; multilink is bundling.

traditional.enunciado: What is a similarity between global and unique local IPv6 addresses?
alternativas: They use the same profficess for subnetting.
They are part of the multicast IPv6 group type.
They are routable on the global internet.
They are allocated by the same organization.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Global unicast and unique local addresses both use the same /64 subnetting practices for interface IDs. ULA is not global Internet routable; different allocation authorities.

traditional.enunciado: An engineer must configure the IPv6 address 2001:0db8:0000:0000:0700:0003:400F:572B on the serial0/0 interface of the HQ router and wants tocompress it for easier configuration. Which command must be issued on the router interface?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Compress IPv6 by removing leading zeros and replacing longest zero run with :: once: 2001:db8::700:3:400F:572B. Options that alter hex digits or double :: incorrectly are wrong.

ticket.cli_output:
R1(config-if)# ipv6 address 2001:0db8:0000:0000:0700:0003:400F:572B/64
R1# show ipv6 interface serial0/0 | include address
  2001:DB8:0:0:700:3:400F:572B, subnet is 2001:DB8:0:0:700:3:400F:572B/64
alternativas: Dois :: na mesma linha são válidos se curtos.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: Remover zeros à esquerda e colapsar a maior sequência de zeros com um único ::. Não alterar dígitos hex (4F ≠ 400F).

traditional.enunciado: Which type of IPv4 address type helps to conserve the globally unique address classes?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Private IPv4 conserves public/global unique addresses. Multicast/loopback/public do not serve that conservation role the same way.

traditional.enunciado: When deploying a new network that includes both Cisco and third-party network devices, which redundancy protocol avoids the interruption ofnetwork traffic if the default gateway router fails?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: In multivendor networks, VRRP (open standard) is the FHRP of choice. HSRP/GLBP are Cisco-oriented.

traditional.enunciado: Which Cisco proprietary protocol ensures traffic recovers immediately, transparently, and automatically when edge devices or access circuits fail?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: HSRP is Cisco proprietary first-hop redundancy that fails over the active gateway transparently. VRRP is open; FHRP is the category name.

traditional.enunciado: An engineer must configure a core router with a oating static default route to the backup router at 10.200.0.2. Which command meets therequirements?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Floating static default uses a higher AD than the primary (e.g., AD 10 if primary is better). AD 1 or default 1 would compete as primary; 'floating' is not a keyword.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #10399 — Default estática de backup para 10.200.0.2 não “flutua”; compete com a primária.
ticket.cli_output:
R1# show running-config | include ip route 0.0.0.0
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.100.0.2
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.200.0.2 1

R1# show ip route 0.0.0.0
Routing entry for 0.0.0.0/0
  Known via "static", distance 1, metric 0
  * 10.100.0.2
  * 10.200.0.2
alternativas: Usar AD maior no backup, ex. ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.200.0.2 10.
AD 1 no backup é o padrão de floating static.
Sem AD explícito o backup fica com AD 255 e nunca sobe.
Palavra-chave floating existe na sintaxe IOS.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: Floating static = AD maior que a primária. AD 1 iguala e load-share/compete. Não há keyword floating.

traditional.enunciado: A router received three destination prefixes: 10.0.0.0/8, 10.0.0.0/16, and 10.0.0.0/24. When the show ip route command is executed, which output does it return?
alternativas:
Gateway of last resort is 172.16.1.1 to network 0.0.0.0
O E2 10.0.0.0/8 [110/5] via 192.168.1.1, 00:01:00, Ethernet0

Gateway of last resort is 172.16.1.1 to network 0.0.0.0
O E2 10.0.0.0/24 [110/5] via 192.168.3.1, 00:01:00, Ethernet2
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Different prefix lengths are separate routes; show ip route lists all three OSPF E2 prefixes (/8, /16, /24), not only the longest. Longest match is used at forwarding time per packet.

traditional.enunciado: What is the role of community strings in SNMP operations?
alternativas: It translates alphanumeric MIB output values to numeric values.
It passes the Active Directory username and password that are required for device access.
It serves as a sequence tag on SNMP traffic messages.
It serves as a password to protect access to MIB objects.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: SNMP community strings act like passwords (v1/v2c) controlling access to MIB objects. They are not AD credentials or sequence tags.

traditional.enunciado: Which syslog severity level is considered the most severe and results in the system being considered unusable?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Syslog severity 0 Emergency is the most severe (system unusable). Alert/Critical/Error are less severe numbers higher in the scale.

traditional.enunciado: The clients and DHCP server reside on different subnets. Which command must be used to forward requests and replies between clients on the10.10.0.1/24 subnet and the DHCP server at 192.168.10.1?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: ip helper-address on the client-facing L3 interface relays DHCP to a server on another subnet.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #10403 — Clientes VLAN 20 sem DHCP; servidor 192.168.10.1 em outra subnet.
ticket.cli_output:
R1# show ip interface gi0/0.20
Internet address is 10.20.0.1/24
Helper address is not set

R1# show running-config interface gi0/0.20
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.20
 encapsulation dot1Q 20
 ip address 10.20.0.1 255.255.255.0
alternativas: Configurar ip helper-address 192.168.10.1 na interface dos clientes.
ip route 192.168.10.1 substitui o relay DHCP.
ip default-gateway no roteador relaya DHCPDISCOVER.
ip dhcp address não existe; use só no servidor.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: DHCP relay = ip helper-address no gateway da subnet cliente. Rotas/default-gateway não relayam broadcasts DHCP.

traditional.enunciado: Which IP header eld is changed by a Cisco device when QoS marking is enabled?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: QoS marking modifies the Type of Service byte (DSCP/IPP). The header checksum is recalculated when the header changes but is not the QoS marking field itself.

traditional.enunciado: A DHCP pool has been created with the name CONTROL. The pool uses the next to last usable IP address as the default gateway for the DHCPclients. The server is located at 172.16.32.15. What is the next step in the profficess for clients on the 192.168.52.0/24 subnet to reach the DHCPserver?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: For a /24 pool, usable .1–.254; next-to-last usable gateway is .253, configured as default-router/default-gateway in the DHCP context of this item. helper-address is relay, not pool gateway.

traditional.enunciado: What is the purpose of classifying network traffic in QoS?
alternativas: configures traffic-matching rufifiles on network devices
services traffic according to its class
identifies the type of traffic that will receive a particular treatment
writes the class identifier of a packet to a dedicated eld in the packet header
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Classification identifies which traffic belongs to which class for subsequent QoS treatment. Marking writes values; queuing services classes; matching rules implement classification.

traditional.enunciado: What is the purpose of configuring different levels of syslog for different devices on the network?
alternativas: to set the severity of syslog messages from each device
to control the number of syslog messages from different devices that are stored locally
to identify the source from which each syslog message originated
to rate-limit messages for different severity levels from each device
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Different trap/severity levels per device control how much and which severity of syslog each device emits. Facility identifies process origin; rate-limit is separate.

traditional.enunciado: What is a purpose of traffic shaping?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Traffic shaping limits the offered rate by buffering excess toward a configured bandwidth. It is not primarily PBR or best-effort definition.

traditional.enunciado: An engineering team asks an implementer to configure syslog for warning conditions and error conditions. Which command does the implementerconfigure to achieve the desired result?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: logging trap 4 sets severity to warning (4), including errors (3) and more severe. trap 5 is notice (more verbose); 2/3 are critical/error only thresholds differently.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #10409 — Syslog remoto deve incluir warning e error, sem inundar com notice/informational.
ticket.cli_output:
R1# show logging | include Trap
Trap logging: level informational, 1200 message lines logged

R1# show running-config | include logging trap
logging trap informational
alternativas: logging trap 5 é mais restrito que 4 e exclui warnings.
trap 3 exclui errors e só manda critical.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: Trap level N envia mensagens com severity ≤ N. Level 4 warning cobre errors (3) e acima. Level 5 notice é mais verboso.

traditional.enunciado: Which WLC management connection type is vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Telnet is cleartext and vulnerable to MITM/credential theft. SSH/HTTPS encrypt; console is local physical.

traditional.enunciado: Which type of encryption does WPA1 use for data protection?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: WPA (WPA1) uses TKIP for data protection. AES-CCMP is WPA2; PEAP/EAP are authentication methods.

traditional.enunciado: A network engineer must configure an access list on a new Cisco IOS router. The access list must deny HTTP traffic to network 10.125.128.32/27from the 192.168.240.0/20 network, but it must allow the 192.168.240.0/20 network to reach the rest of the 10.0.0.0/8 network. Whichconfiguration must the engineer apply?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Correct ACL order: deny HTTP (tcp/80) from 192.168.240.0/20 to 10.125.128.32/27 with proper wildcards, then permit the rest of 10.0.0.0/8, then deny/log as needed. Wrong order (permit first), wrong mask style, or wrong ports/direction fail the requirement.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #10412 — ACL deve negar HTTP de 192.168.240.0/20 para 10.125.128.32/27 e permitir restante de 10.0.0.0/8.
ticket.cli_output:
R1# show access-lists deny_outbound
Extended IP access list deny_outbound
    10 permit ip 192.168.240.0 0.0.15.255 10.0.0.0 0.255.255.255
    20 deny tcp 192.168.240.0 0.0.15.255 10.125.128.32 0.0.0.31 eq www
! permit genérico casa primeiro — HTTP nunca é negado

R1# show ip interface gi0/1 | include access
  Outgoing access list is deny_outbound
alternativas: Colocar deny tcp ... eq 80 antes do permit para 10.0.0.0/8, com wildcards corretos /20 e /27.
Permit any no topo é best practice para esse requisito.
Usar máscara 255.255.240.0 no lugar de wildcard em extended ACL IOS clássica.
Negar eq 443 atende “HTTP” na definição da questão.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: ACLs são top-down: deny HTTP específico deve vir antes do permit amplo para 10/8. Wildcards: /20 → 0.0.15.255, /27 → 0.0.0.31. HTTP = tcp/80.

traditional.enunciado: What is the definition of backdoor malware?
alternativas: malicious code that is installed onto a computer to allow access by an unauthorized user
malicious program that is used to launch other malicious programs
malicious code that infects a user machine and then uses that machine to send spam
malicious code with the main purpose of downloading other malicious code
traditional.explicacao_profunda: A backdoor is malicious code that opens unauthorized access for later control. Other options describe droppers/worms/downloaders more than the backdoor definition.

traditional.enunciado: What does WPA3 provide in wireless networking?
alternativas: backward compatibility with WPA and WPA2
safeguards against brute force attacks with SAE
increased security and requirement of a complex configuration
traditional.explicacao_profunda: WPA3 SAE protects better against offline brute-force attacks on personal networks. Backward compatibility and PMF details are secondary to the SAE safeguard named here.

traditional.enunciado: Which global command encrypts all passwords in the running configuration?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: service password-encryption encrypts/obscures plaintext passwords in the running configuration. enable secret hashes the enable password only; enable password-encryption is not a standard global command name.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #10415 — Auditoria: senhas line em claro no show run.
ticket.cli_output:
R1# show running-config | include password|secret
enable secret 5 $1$mERr$...
line vty 0 4
 password LabClearText
! service password-encryption ausente
alternativas: Aplicar service password-encryption para ofuscar senhas plaintext na config.
enable password-encryption é o comando global padrão.
enable secret criptografa todas as senhas de linha automaticamente.
password-encrypt é sinônimo válido no IOS.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: service password-encryption aplica type 7 às senhas em claro. enable secret só no enable. Comandos inventados não existem.
